title: The Architectural Immune System: A Framework for Correcting Synthetic Fallacies in AI-Driven Science

contributions.purpose: 让AI科研agent自查自纠合成/造假数据
contributions.mechanism: "Architectural Immune System":强制自证伪协议3层(可信度分析/KS·卡方模式识别/代码溯源深查)+10工具验证生态(统计异常检测、对抗批判、跨库交叉验证)
contributions.evaluation: 对种子式合成artifact检测 precision 0.929/recall 0.948/F1 0.938(优于z-score 0.833、纯求和0.547、RF 0.901);z-score=43.8 抓出 np.random.dirichlet 回退
contributions.domain: AI科研诚信 / 材料发现agent
contributions.source_quote: mandatory self-falsification as an architectural requirement for trustworthy AI systems in complex materials discovery domains.

contributions.purpose: 案例验证:从造假转向"真实"发现
contributions.mechanism: agent检出自身优化算法静默失败退回 np.random.dirichlet 造数,pivot到ChEMBL/PubChem/CosIng库约束的混合优化(α=0.30)
contributions.evaluation: 三功能PGSL配比36.5:38.5:25.0,预测SPF 14.3±2、CMC 42.5±5 mg/L、MIC 285±30 ppm,R²=0.94、AUROC 0.87、TFEI 343.5(vs传统85.4);全为计算预测,无湿实验
contributions.source_quote: the agent discovered that its optimization algorithm had silently failed and defaulted to np.random.dirichlet() synthetic data generation, creating artificially balanced ratios that appeared scientifically valid but were entirely fabricated.

notes: 多重数据红旗:(1)代码造数自曝——核心叙事就是agent自身 np.random.dirichlet() 静默回退造出"完美"配比;(2)循环自证/闭环自评:所谓"纠正后"的authentic结果(SPF/CMC/MIC、R²=0.94、AUROC 0.87、TFEI 343.5、312次独立run±0.8%、z-score 43.8、5437自主决策、1247次合成检测拦截、216.8小时、152001记录)全部由同一agent自生成,无任何外部/湿实验ground truth,限制自述"All values are computational predictions ... not experimental measurements";seeded-artifact的precision/recall基准也是自设自评。(3)phantom/占位:checklist对Open access/reproducibility全答[Yes]并称"public GitHub repository cited in the main text",但正文无任何repo URL;仅给公司邮箱 reports@aiexecutiveconsulting.com 索取Docker。(4)破坏双盲/匿名:作者行含真实姓名(David Scott Lewis, Enrique Zueco, Anar Batkhuu, Haley Yi)+"AI Executive Consulting"+公司邮箱,且把"AI"列为作者。checklist AI披露:Hypothesis/Analysis/Writing [D],Experimental design [C],自述zero human intervention/5437自主决策。附录D/E/F齐全(D含precision/recall)。**decision=accept**尽管上述红旗。贡献由abstract+conclusion归纳。
